title: Tools: Excel, Power BI, Tableau and code libraries

videos.script: Picture the same chart made three times. Once in a spreadsheet, once in a business intelligence tool, and once in a few lines of Python. {{three}} Done well, you should not be able to tell which is which. Each one gets a title that makes a claim, sorted bars from zero, one colour and its values. {{same}} The tools differ in how fast the first chart appears, how much of it you can change, and where the steps are kept. {{differ}} They do not differ in what makes a chart honest and readable. Every rule in this course is a setting somewhere, in a menu or in a line of code. {{rules}} This last lesson compares the families of tools and says what each does well. It ends where the course began: with a chart drawn twice, and the question of whether it is the same chart. {{plan}}
